problemSolution.title: Outdated Sirens Can't Save Modern Campuses
problemSolution.description: Legacy analog systems suffer from minutes-long latency and zero contextual awareness. CampusAlert Pro delivers a digital mesh that responds in milliseconds.

features.title: Engineered for Every Second of an Emergency
features.description: A vertically integrated platform combining edge AI, geospatial intelligence, and zero-trust security.

items.title: Instant Alerts
items.description: Sub-second FCM push notifications for severe weather, active threats, or facility lockdowns — delivered with full context and severity.

items.title: Smart Detection
items.description: On-device TensorFlow Lite classification flags distress anomalies — glass-break, screams — locally without streaming audio to the cloud.

items.title: Emergency Mapping
items.description: Dynamic Google Maps routing guides users away from active hazard vectors via GeoJSON overlays and geofenced safe zones.

items.title: Encrypted Security
items.description: AES-256 end-to-end encryption, MFA, and SAML 2.0 SSO ensure total institutional privacy and FERPA / GDPR compliance.
